sn24.14:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.14:1.4: bhagavammūlakā no bhante, dhammā …pe… rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati …pe… vedanāya sati …pe… saññāya sati …pe… saṅkhāresu sati …pe… viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati : “aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra”nti. taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti? …pe… api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya : “aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra”nti? no hetaṃ bhante. vedanā …pe… saññā …pe… saṅkhārā …pe… viññāṇaṃ …pe… yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti. …pe… api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya : “aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra”nti? no hetaṃ bhante. yato kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa …pe…
